title: Meet Marisol
body: Marisol verifies home care visits for a 32-caregiver agency. Here is her Monday morning before and after this tool.

title: Every visit in one list
body: Last week's visits, already checked against the state EVV file, with the ones that need a person at the top.

title: The whole story of a visit
body: Who was scheduled, when the caregiver clocked in, what the state aggregator returned, and every call and note since.

title: A visit missing its clock-out
body: Dwayne clocked in at 8:02am and never clocked out. The visit is flagged with the reason in plain words, not a code.

title: The address that moved
body: The family moved two apartments over and nobody updated the client profile, so a perfectly good visit looks wrong.

title: Marisol signs off
body: Corrected hours, the family's confirmation, and one button. Nothing reaches the payer or payroll until she clicks it.

title: The numbers that matter
body: Visits waiting, caregiver hours on hold, this week's exception rate, and how long exceptions take to clear.

title: How this would be built
body: The verification queue sits between the scheduling system, the caregiver app, and the state EVV aggregator, with a human approval before anything reaches claims or payroll.
